sources.68936a7a672ffe94a509446b description: He that steals honey, should beware of the sting.
sources.6751aedd068276747529227a description: Basic walls for a basic Tarkov citizen. Somewhat reminiscent of an old Soviet hospital.
sources.6751af2d8e1a942952aefef2 description: For those who seek peace and tranquility. Each hare and butterfly are hand-painted. A real master's work.
sources.6751af383e9bd9caef89db33 description: For Red mains. If anyone manages to sneak into your Hideout, the blood on the walls won't be as noticeable.
sources.6751af3fcb1d39998bfac87b description: The floor that came with the Hideout. If it's cleaned up, it would look "okay".
sources.6751af495b5b6eb3f4bf3e8c description: Perfect flooring for those who appreciate simplicity. And those who never take their shoes off.
sources.6751af8bdbb573047940a042 description: How did these drawings even get here? You should probably improve your security system.
sources.67547d0f059224f355d52c34 description: A floor exclusively for walking barefoot. However, it looks like real grass only from a distance.
sources.6757f7abb3db18ca36b80fa8 description: A target for the most precise.
sources.6757f843ef44ccd9cae9b4cd description: A target for real hunters. Making Jaeger proud.
sources.6757f86db8c6e4b9a80b3fd2 description: Let's see what kind of a shot you are, pilgrim. Take a crack at this bottle.
sources.6757f88b8455992ca790d75f description: A contrast of sectors allows you to shoot more accurately.
sources.6757f8a88e1a324c7432def2 description: A target that brings some variety to shooting practice.
sources.67584568886bcb95b7a4a7f7 description: For Blue mains. Blue is believed to be a calming color for the nervous system. With walls like this, you should be able to sleep better. A good lock on the door would help too.
sources.6758457c00ddf9fdaedf71e6 description: Fully exposed walls for brutalism lovers.
sources.6758458ea8fc011dd69a07a0 description: If you gaze long enough at these drawings, it will seem like they are gazing back at you.
sources.675845a78fc07a5b49df8378 description: For those who want to turn their Hideout into a trendy loft. Exposing the brick and removing layers of plaster takes quite a bit of effort. Hopefully, it's worth it.
sources.675845be076a984e69514f91 description: A fun color to elevate your mood. Or to go completely insane in a cheerful way.
sources.675845d08f12ba371ca6efa5 description: The luxury of silence. And marble.
sources.675845ef558bd99a397f1423 description: Who would actually think of decorating their Hideout in the style of an industrial factory? An ex-worker, obviously. Or someone with unusual tastes.
sources.675846123eb1552410f949e5 description: A surefire solution. Too bad this is the only wallpaper style you could find.
sources.67584672d50f6d3dec589959 description: Has a warm, familiar feel to it. It bounces underfoot and looks nice.
sources.675846870ef524572ad413b5 description: A good coating that requires little maintenance. Practical and stylish.
sources.675846a8606febda61651929 description: Is it actual marble or is it merely pretending to be? Either way, be careful: marble floors are usually very slippery.
sources.675846ccf4e8484562b07782 description: A brilliant solution for a manufacturing plant, but somewhat questionable for a living space. Who are we to stop you, though?
sources.675846f71b2620cfbdcbb438 description: Mechanic shared his favorite style. Too bad he didn't warn in advance that such floors are very awkward to clean.
sources.67584709106d54460af75877 description: Your grandma probably had the same flooring. Or your friend's grandma. Either way, it looks good.
sources.6758472232e5ca2c980a17ff description: Classic parquet. Wood and lacquer - nothing extra.
sources.6758517669cfc0195e555532 description: A charming ceiling for those who don't like the outdoors. Why leave the house when you can just paint the sun on the ceiling?
sources.675851bba67b0f994b89bd24 description: An untidy ceiling for those who don't care about the looks. It doesn't leak, and that's all that matters.
sources.675851d0e6b8a9cbae3e5aba description: Who in their right mind would paint something on the ceiling? Be on your guard: there's no telling what else these people might come up with.
sources.675851e45338344d8fe1ce6f description: Nothing special. Luckily there are no spider webs. Unless?
sources.6758521199c7b5040d87468d description: Visually makes the room look larger. A good choice for those who like more air.
sources.6758522a4d6d6674cd50e38f description: A non-fake, original production drop ceiling, the good stuff. For those who are particularly sensitive, it may evoke memories of office life from the past.
sources.6758523adf0e5f08d1d5c132 description: Unmaintained, but sturdy ceiling. When you look at it, you feel a strange desire to visit Factory once more.
sources.6758524ec55b4ffd1b46cfc2 description: The simplest of ceiling finishes. All the seams are sealed, no stains. It's not very cozy, but it does its main function quite well.
sources.67585260c0250fb99b3b9113 description: Looks like someone tried to whitewash it, but something went wrong. Your grandma's basement must have had one just like it.
sources.675a99f30fba9efc6a40481d description: Just an ordinary target, nothing special.
sources.67adb25c7a0e0fce8574438c description: They say our surroundings affect us. It's terrifying to imagine what someone would become after turning an ordinary shelter into the Minotaur's dungeon.
sources.67adb38d0217ccce16b5b08c description: The tiles on this floor have absorbed gallons of blood. Or perhaps even more.
sources.67adb4843fec17bf3ea9452e description: This ceiling is nothing sophisticated. The Minotaur doesn't need anything like that.
sources.6841c93d40f98448eafbe5fe description: A target for those who miss all the bar games.
sources.6841ca25a3202eb499cdee19 description: A target for sneaky rodent hunters.
sources.6841caa796e886f328e69606 description: Crows are clever birds. But in image form, they certainly won't outsmart you. Unless?
sources.6841cc541c407f8aa0e4f62b description: White walls will make the Hideout look more spacious. Like an office.
sources.6841ccf5cf47eb290b9fb24e description: A nice light-colored floor. Helps keep the eyes free of strain. It also keeps the dust almost invisible.
sources.6841cdb93de393b52dd49865 description: A white ceiling with gold inlays. Someone went to a lot of trouble to paint these stripes.
sources.686051774a290eb6f216471f description: I tracked down tracked down a shipment of NATO weapons that was delivered to Customs. We aren't sure what the weapons are, but I want you to go and track them down and mark the shipment for me!
sources.691ecb9b1664a484f03a2611 description: Kill 25 PMCs with the FNX-45 Tactical .45 ACP pistol
sources.691ecbb23b845bc0903a2612 description: Kill 50 PMCs with the FNX-45 Tactical .45 ACP pistol
sources.691ecbc872bfcbd28b3a2616 description: Kill 100 PMCs with the FNX-45 Tactical .45 ACP pistol
sources.3f8d2c5a9b17e04d6ca8f312 description: I went over to the guys, we had a real good talk... When you're ready, just come see me and I'll tell you everything, uh... In person!
sources.6a4de4da46604165ad7d0ce1 description: Great! With the cameras installed, I need you to keep a close eye on what Mechanic is going to do about this. Don't screw this up!
sources.6a7d316935bfdf8609748f7a description: Tracking Mechanic's moves doesn't mean breaking the cameras I had you plant. Look... honestly, whatever. This was all a waste of time. Just go on with your life in Tarkov.
sources.6a4de6851d3fc0503f000c17 description: Well, I don't think Mechanic is someone worth having as an enemy. I spoke with him recently over the radio and we made some deals. We expect you to act as a bridge here.
sources.690a553efc51c1efb8c22ded description: My next operation will be crucial. Customs has been a turbulent environment, so you will recon the area and get out in one piece. You will have new tasks to do.
sources.690a659d592d4e5a142036bb description: My team is already doing the hard work on Customs, but these Scavs are annoying; they cause trouble, so ensure they have the necessary support.
sources.6912c61d527bc3f9790b5776 description: It is time to continue practicing, and obviously, our expectations of you are increasing. You need to keep training with Western weapons if you wish to reach an exemplary standard. We are counting on you.
sources.6913fe5afc7a709d1e0aeba6 description: The beautiful P90. It was manufactured by FN Herstal, the same manufacturer as the Five-seveN. Powerful caliber and surprising fire rate, making it worthy of a challenge to match.
sources.69141e39dc0b928717fdd14b description: I'm not such a fan of SIG Sauer weapons, with the exception of their pistols, but the AR configuration makes many adore this submachine gun, so it will be part of the test. Have a nice trip to Customs.
sources.6914eaa069904863f3247ecd description: Another high-standard DMR. Perfect stability and an impressive fire rate, besides having a resemblance to the AR configuration as well. I just handed you some good things, so it's time to put them into action.
sources.691509a8317f46ac275c10c4 description: We have reached the Sniper Rifles. My people rely heavily on precision, patience, and calm, so this time I want to demand a little more accuracy from you. I am sure you are capable.
sources.69156abce46a469364c4a8ff description: To be an established member of the ISB, good medical knowledge and physical preparation are necessary. Let's start by improving your capabilities.
sources.69156f0aaf9e9c284214e0db description: You collected some items, so let's continue at this same pace and also practice using medications. I await your news!
sources.69614f3852b2d48240d8d604 description: Let's play UNTAR's game and make it look like we actually care about this failed operation of theirs. Get a bit closer to their representative around here, and we'll move forward that way.
sources.69b4501e1b72aba5140989fe description: 50 Million Roubles!? You've got to be kidding me. That's over 300 thousand dollars! If this helps find those bastards, it might just be the right call. I'll make some calls and update you as soon as I can.
sources.6a3cb7cff815823fa45ce5d8 description: We have a lot to wrap our heads around. My people checked the drive and it is heavily encrypted. We asked Mechanic to help with it. Follow up with him and return when you have results.
sources.690e2689cbd10f2ac5e766eb description: I heard you're looking for information about some people. They are led by an extremely dangerous woman; her operations put Tarkov and everyone involved at risk. Don't hand this over to anyone but me.
sources.690f6e1e9e966ad660423991 description: She is satisfied with your previous performance. I have a few leftover orders from her; find the equipment and bring it. Don't forget to test it; they are very fresh and require fully functional weapons.
sources.691240a442a8c7334f0aa46e description: Hello, mercenary. The last modifications were great. I had to replace some of the original parts you brought, but everything went as planned. We have a second batch of orders.
sources.6a3cc68cf7263a67e12db4ac description: Hello again! My system reports that the download is complete. However, since the information is encrypted, I don't have remote access to it. Head back to The Lab and grab the Flash Drive. Good luck!
sources.69a9e0c6feecd672795d259b description: An explosion at Lighthouse? I hadn't heard about it, but it's certainly not very common to get explosives around here. That's definitely the work of those damn Scavs.
sources.69a9e13ce82619b85edf32ed description: Explosives? Lighthouse? That's not my problem, and I don't even want to get involved with those Rogues. Now, please, I need to focus on my business.
sources.69aa071620304e3c448378fc description: That's not very common in Tarkov, did anyone get hurt? Well, I'd like to help if I could, but I don't know anything. I hope you find the answers you're looking for, mercenary!
sources.69b59f5cd76c01b7117e2712 description: Did your bosses accept the terms? Then we have a deal. 50 million, no more, no less—and I guarantee you'll find out something very interesting.
sources.69a9e71f596a6d5cc7ad6cd8 description: Hey comrade, how's it going? You know how business is, there are things we hear around, but they're more complicated than they seem, so I really can't help you with this Lighthouse thing.
sources.6924bcbfcb0c0c86b8f1aff6 description: Complete a classified operation in line with ISB's objectives for the first time.
sources.6924c9c60db281e82adaf1df description: Uncover and explore the intentions of those who orchestrate the chaos in Tarkov behind the scenes.
sources.694178105154d75f7a0cfd10 description: Embrace your destiny by working alongside the ISB to dismantle and destroy all the corruption plaguing Tarkov
sources.6941763c6b2e0c64d04ef254 description: Locate and neutralize ISB operatives carrying Pawn dogtags (Regular Operatives, Heavy Operatives and Marksman) 50 times.
sources.69417646c9c13c9353996c4e description: Locate and neutralize ISB operatives carrying Pawn dogtags (Regular Operatives, Heavy Operatives and Marksman) 150 times.
sources.6941764b021c3b1630cf28d5 description: Locate and neutralize ISB operatives carrying Pawn dogtags (Regular Operatives, Heavy Operatives and Marksman) 300 times.
sources.694176509df5de06f529631f description: Dive into the corruption of the world and uncover UNTAR’s ties to TerraGroup.
sources.694176555b56f8b3181945b1 description: Investigate and uncover UNTAR’s covert operations on behalf of TerraGroup and Unheard, and get ready to expose them.
sources.694178a7bdec6f74d1f3585a description: Use all the evidence and overcome the pressure from the United Nations in favor of the ISB.
sources.694bf54ab3c3a56da952d2f4 description: Find out about a secret player in the power play in Tarkov
sources.694bf5aefeed87068122e731 description: Find out all the operational details about the Black Division in Tarkov and the evidence they’re trying to hide.
sources.694bf5bc5b0d85dce4d4a3c5 description: Triumphe with ISB and completely dismantle Black Division’s operations in Tarkov while you wait for their final breath at Terminal.
sources.6a6ab405957e20e3ed0af439 description: Now that those shits have stopped eavesdropping on other people's conversations, let's teach them a lesson, ISB style. Find some Raiders and wipe them off the map.
sources.6a6abd124b41bb872e356393 description: I already know... Honestly, I almost never have contact with this sort of Federation Fence created. These Scavs just cause headaches, but if it involves Aishi, we'll take a look.
sources.5f369eeac01a188bc7dc06d0 description: Well, you've been with me for a while in these operations, so let's do the following. I can guarantee that you won't be targeted by my people during raids, but let's practice your role within the "ISB". Deal?
sources.935421a346e854a6d2337c37 description: Currently, my network relies on the highly useful participation of Mechanic and Jaeger. I need to make sure you don't disappoint them either; after all, you want my trust? You need to have theirs too.
sources.ba02d1c72f3ca4c5d6625bf2 description: You did your part. This radio can be used to broadcast your presence in the area. My people will not consider you hostile while you are using it.
sources.52588eccea984354a13b53f4 description: I don't care about Skier's clients. What is happening in The Lab is far too serious for us to care about that. Take out those Raiders and PMCs that are causing trouble and that should settle it.
sources.1184c00a9ec847be987be767 description: It's quite audacious for this madman to want to mess with my "White Tusks". Ignore this nonsense and keep helping with the research against these mercenaries. We need to find out more about them.
sources.8e039d03e80f41788f9b9819 description: This “ISB” has an extremely skilled squad called “White Tusks.” I don't care what they do at Labs, but I don't want them causing trouble outside of it. Deal with them.
sources.dd715e78ab984c14909da407 description:
Hello, mercenary. Aishi sent me some reports of what is happening in The Lab, and to sum it up for you: total chaos.

If you are here, I imagine you want to help, so go to the lab and do some recon.
sources.9dfc181b7e2944bd9d40308b description: While I work on the structural part of the lab and the systems, help Aishi with her tasks. It is also possible that other traders might be interested.
sources.a5933b154fe34593947956c8 description: This "ISB" always gives me a headache. Mercenary, are you seeing what they are doing in The Lab? Neutralize some of their commanders for me, that will help disorganize the squad.
sources.1f6a892b5dda4241868ffd09 description: Looks like that crazy place is suffocating everyone after a while. Respirators aren't enough to save you, but they delay total oxygen loss. Get some for me.
sources.8e4f5535e0bf4135b8a90ec7 description: You managed to extract all the data? Great! With it, we can put an end to this sick TerraGroup experiment once and for all and prepare for any eventuality.
sources.6a5d3f64a8b2157267046245 description: Locate and neutralize ISB Special Agents (Team Leaders, Specialists, Scouts and Assassins) 30 times.
sources.6a5d3f7ffc741ffbbf091b8e description: Locate and neutralize ISB Special Agents (Team Leaders, Specialists, Scouts and Assassins) 90 times.
sources.6a5d3f83cfd86f66e72d47a5 description: Locate and neutralize ISB Special Agents (Team Leaders, Specialists, Scouts and Assassins) 150 times.
sources.6a5d422c743a1afbb2183f54 description: Locate and neutralize "The Chosen One" and "The Dark Lord" in a single raid.
sources.6a5d431a5243a4c3a0d2afe9 description: Locate and neutralize "The Chosen One" and "The Dark Lord" 30 times.
sources.1d9f3fb317d15e2a77957327 description: Contribute to the ISB and expel the Black Division forces from The Lab by completing the entire Aishi's quest line for the “Containment Breach” event.
sources.1c69974a9de656678427b103 description: Eliminate each of the seven White Tusks members at least once.
sources.9df3731674b1b81ebec38ce4 description: Survive the decontamination protocol at Labs during the “Containment Breach” event for 10 minutes and extract from the raid.
sources.c447fc786e04524e87d4ea8a description: Overcome the Black Division and obtain information from the C.A.S.S.I.E. system for the ISB during the “Containment Breach” event.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000002 description: One of my manifests has too many names still marked active. Bring me five PMC dogtags. I don't care which patch they wore. I need proof before I move restricted weapons off the books.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000004 description: A scav crew has been hitting the Customs route I use to move protective equipment inland. Twelve of them should be enough to make the next convoy boring again. I like boring convoys.
sources.71a001f1a11ce00100000005 description: The public manifest is clean. The other ledger isn't. I need eight tags from operators level twenty-five or higher before I move the next rifle and ammunition allotment out of reserve.
sources.66c1565e796a61e8a711e6d9 description: Alright, theres a few more things I could sell, higher quality equipment than before. Get your skills up, all of them. And keep training them, report back to me when you feel comfortable.

keptAsIs.625d700aefebc4442a7b3875 description: Механик_049 — 모드가 쓰는 내부 이름이다. 화면에 뜻이 있는 말이 아니다
